page.overview:
Who is Ramath?

Ramath is a non-canon character that made his one and only appearance to date in the animated series, Mortal Kombat: Defenders of the Realm, where he was voiced by Brock Peters. He was an elderly male who was known to be the Keeper of the Crystal Realm.

Ramath was known to be a close friend of Princess Kitana's father, the king of the Realm of Edenia. The young Kitana learned much from the elderly man, who survived Shao Kahn's invasion and incorporation of the realm into Outworld. After his close friend's death, Ramath would help guide the young Kitana over the centuries; acting like a second father to the princess.

During the rebellion planned with Zara against Shao Kahn, Ramath found himself and Kitana betrayed by Zara, who attempted to gain the Swords of Ilkan in order to be the undisputed master of the realms. Ramath was mortally wounded in the conflict and died.
